business_problem: Equinor needs to maintain safe, efficient, and profitable operations across offshore platforms and land facilities while improving geological understanding, planning wells and field development better, reducing unplanned shutdown risk, and supporting production and value creation on the Norwegian continental shelf through 2035.
solution_summary: Equinor describes a portfolio of in-house AI solutions embedded in industrial operations rather than a single standalone application. The implementation uses operational data from industrial processes, including 24,000 sensors monitoring more than 700 rotating machines across facilities, plus seismic datasets and well-planning inputs from field development work. Equinor says it primarily applies traditional machine learning to this operational data to predict equipment failures and maintenance needs, generate thousands of well and field-development alternatives, and accelerate seismic interpretation. Model outputs are served directly into expert and operator workflows on offshore platforms and land facilities, where engineers can focus on the best proposals, improve facility operations, and expand geological understanding. The source does not name storage platforms or external vendors, but it clearly shows AI integrated into production decision-making and day-to-day industrial execution.
data_flow: Operational sensor data from rotating machines, seismic data, and well-planning inputs feed Equinor's machine-learning workflows. The models predict failures and maintenance needs, generate large numbers of planning alternatives, and speed seismic interpretation. Results are consumed by experts and operators on offshore platforms and land facilities to choose plans, guide field development, and run facilities more safely and efficiently.
business_outcome: Equinor reports substantial value creation from AI in industrial processes, including lower failure and shutdown risk, more efficient facility operations, better well and field development planning, and much faster seismic interpretation.
